_comment: OPTIONAL operator override for the dead-channel deny-list. Copy this to dead-channels.local.json (gitignored) ONLY if you want to extend or shadow the committed dead-channels.json without making a commit. If dead-channels.local.json exists, buffer-post-prep reads it INSTEAD OF dead-channels.json (it does not merge — copy the committed rows in if you want to keep them). Same shape as dead-channels.json: each row matches a channel by `channel_id` OR by `service`+`handle`, and `reason` is the human-readable skip text. An empty list (or a missing file) skips nothing.
